purpose: Assess derived-settings trajectory guidance against L1 in changing wind, without truth wind in navigation.
courses: torture with four protected pass-beyond waypoints
randomisation: Independent seed per course, severity and replicate; identical time-indexed targets per controller pair; alternating execution order.
weather: Two independent stationary OU components at 1Hz, random mean direction, four equally weighted engineering severity strata, plus native SITL horizontal/vertical turbulence. Spatially uniform.
wind_estimator: AHRS_EKF_TYPE=3 / EK3_ENABLE=1. SIM AHRS type10 is never selected.
seed_limitation: Seeds control OU schedules; native sensor/turbulence PRNG realisations are not guaranteed bit-identical between paired flights.
success: Armed AUTO to terminal command, finite states, altitude 60..150m, bank magnitude <=65deg, protected waypoint passage checked. Course <=1800 simulation seconds.
coverage: Fraction of 10m longitudinal bins visited within 10m of each requested survey line and within15deg of intended course; 600m by320m survey area.
overshoot: Identical outgoing-track window -150m..min(150m,80percent leg length), common corners across paired controllers, grouped internal legs excluded for both.
weather_delivery: Local instrumented SITL replay applies weather at the physics step, verified from its sequential application journal, exact target values, expected count and <=0.25s lateness.
primary_reporting: All failure and fallback counts retained. Timing comparisons conditional on both paired flights succeeding; coverage reported for all raster flights.
uncertainty: 5000 paired bootstrap resamples for mean relative timing, seeded20261008. Small stratified engineering experiment, not a climatic distribution or reliability certification.
local_harness_dependencies: Separate local SITL replay binary; temporary SIMState.cpp instrumentation is restored after building. No Lua, new firmware parameters or bindings required.
discarded_trials: All diagnostic-* folders hold superseded instrumentation trials; final comparison uses schema5 physics-clock replay only.
